summary: Iteration 7 testing of View/Clip production security hardening. All features verified: TOTP encryption at rest, 10 recovery codes on 2FA enable, login via recovery codes (one-time use), recovery code regeneration, key rotation re-encrypts TOTP secrets, public /api/health & /api/ready probes, X-Request-ID middleware, admin system health v1.4.0, and brute-force anomaly alerts. Frontend UI fully verified including TOTP step with recovery code placeholder, TwoFactorCard with regenerate flow, and Notifications page with ShieldAlert icon for security_anomaly.

backend_public_endpoints: GET /api/health - public (no auth), returns 200 with {status:'ok', version:'1.4.0'}
GET /api/ready - public (no auth), returns {status:'ready'} when DB healthy
backend_x_request_id: Every response carries X-Request-ID header (auto-generated UUID4)
When client supplies X-Request-ID, it is echoed back exactly
backend_2fa_encryption: TOTP secret stored ENCRYPTED (Fernet) in users.totp_secret
POST /api/admin/auth/2fa/disable works after secret was stored encrypted (decrypt path)
backend_recovery_codes: POST /api/admin/auth/login with recovery code in totp_code field signs admin in (200, portal=staff)
Same recovery code does NOT work a second time (401)
audit_log contains action=admin.auth.recovery_used with meta.remaining decreasing after each use
POST /api/admin/auth/2fa/recovery-codes/regenerate with valid 6-digit TOTP returns 10 fresh codes
Old recovery codes are invalidated after regeneration (old code returns 401)
backend_key_rotation: POST /api/admin/system/rotate-keys response includes totp_rotated & totp_failed counts
Post-rotation, the SAME TOTP authenticator still works for login (re-encryption seamless)
backend_admin_system_health: Health includes firewall and encryption fields
backend_anomaly_alerts: 3 failed admin login attempts for same email within 5 minutes creates notification type=security_anomaly (kind=brute_force)
frontend_admin_login: /admin/login TOTP step shows placeholder '000000  or  XXXX-XXXX-XXXX'
TOTP step has hint line mentioning 'recovery codes'
frontend_twofactor_card: Admin Command Center → System tab → TwoFactorCard present (data-testid=twofa-card)
After 2FA enabled, shows Regenerate recovery codes button (twofa-regenerate-btn)
Clicking regenerate reveals twofa-regen-panel with twofa-regen-code-input + twofa-regen-confirm-btn
Entering valid 6-digit TOTP code triggers recovery overlay (twofa-recovery-card)
Recovery overlay shows 10 codes (twofa-recovery-codes-list) with Copy, Download, and 'I've saved them' buttons
frontend_notifications: Notifications page renders ShieldAlert icon (lucide) for security_anomaly notifications
Brute-force and recovery-used notifications display correctly

critical_code_review_comments: TOTP secrets correctly encrypted at rest using Fernet (vault_encrypt/vault_decrypt)
Recovery codes generated with cryptographically secure secrets.choice()
Recovery codes stored as bcrypt hashes, only plain codes shown once to user
Recovery code verification uses constant-time bcrypt comparison
Key rotation correctly re-encrypts all TOTP secrets with new cipher
RequestIDMiddleware correctly echoes client-provided X-Request-ID or generates UUID4
Public health/ready endpoints correctly bypass auth middleware
_check_admin_anomalies correctly detects brute-force (3+ failures in 5 min) and new IP logins

success_rate.backend: 100% (12 passed, 3 skipped due to test ordering)

test_credentials.pyotp: Used pyotp.TOTP(secret).now() to generate valid TOTP codes during testing

seed_data_creation: Multiple brute-force attempts created for anomaly alert testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 completes production security hardening. TOTP secrets are now encrypted at rest with Fernet. 10 one-time recovery codes are issued on 2FA enable and can be regenerated. Recovery codes work for login (one-time use). Key rotation re-encrypts TOTP secrets seamlessly. Public /api/health and /api/ready probes added for k8s. X-Request-ID middleware added. Brute-force detection creates security_anomaly notifications. Version is 1.4.0. IMPORTANT: Admin account left with 2FA DISABLED as requested.

mocked_apis.Google Cloud Live Stream: POST /api/streams returns mock ingest/playback URLs when GCP creds not configured

totp_encryption.storage: TOTP secrets encrypted with Fernet (AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256)
totp_encryption.key_rotation: Re-encryption seamless - same authenticator works after rotation

recovery_codes.generation: 10 codes in XXXX-XXXX-XXXX format using cryptographically secure random
recovery_codes.storage: Bcrypt hashes only - plain codes shown once
recovery_codes.usage: One-time use, remaining count tracked in audit_log
recovery_codes.regeneration: Requires valid TOTP code, invalidates all old codes

public_probes.health: GET /api/health - always 200 if process up, returns version
public_probes.ready: GET /api/ready - 503 if any DB layer fails

request_tracing.x_request_id: Auto-generated UUID4 or echoed from client header

anomaly_detection.brute_force: 3+ failed attempts in 5 min triggers notification to all admins
anomaly_detection.new_ip: Login from never-seen IP (after prior success) triggers notification

frontend_ui.admin_login_totp_step: Placeholder shows recovery code format, accepts 20 chars
frontend_ui.twofactor_card: Setup, enable, disable, regenerate flows all working
